heading_en: Transitional Measures for the Amount Exceeding the 15% Threshold for Specified Items
summary_ja: 適用日から5年間、第8条第10項第1号の適用上、15%基準額の算式の文言を読み替える。
summary_en: For five years from the Application Date, replaces the wording of Article 8, paragraph (10), item (i) of the Public Notice so that the 15% threshold is computed without the specified-items deduction and the division by 85%.
paragraphs: With respect to the application of Article 8, paragraph (10), item (i) of the Public Notice during the period until the date five years have elapsed from the Application Date, in that provision, the phrase "the amount obtained by multiplying by 15% the amount obtained by deducting the total of the amounts listed in items (i) through (iv) of paragraph (2) of that Article and the amount of specified items, and dividing the result by 85%" is deemed to be replaced with "the amount obtained by multiplying by 15% the amount obtained by deducting the total of the amounts listed in items (i) through (iv) of paragraph (2) of that Article."
